target_customer: Employers buying corporate wellness for employees
problem: Corporate wellness programs had low engagement and did not lower health costs; desk workers lacked easy healthy habits.
business_model: B2B subscription to employers with a rewards network paid by brand partners

founders.name: Melike Abacioglu Gunes
founders.background_notes: From a 2016 Webrazzi article. Idea came from her Harvard work on big data and preventive health.

founders.name: Firdevs Abacioglu
founders.background_notes: From the same Webrazzi article. Sister of Melike.

competitors.name: Virgin Pulse
competitors.what: Employee wellness, engagement and rewards platform
competitors.traction_then: Reported 2,200 clients in 185 countries after 2016 deals
competitors.funding_then: Acquired competitors ShapeUp and Global Corporate Challenge in 2016

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile app with wearable integrations (Fitbit, Jawbone, Apple Health per Webrazzi) and a rewards network is standard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Many wellness platforms existed and the product was copyable; employer sales relationships were the only real barrier.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The wellness market consolidated in 2016 with Virgin Pulse acquisitions and Welltok taking Keas assets.

market_need_then: Employers spent heavily on wellness and the market was consolidating; Virgin Pulse put the market at 1.2 billion dollars in 2016 for employee wellness, engagement and rewards.

branding.domain_note: Company used physioh.com, a shortened domain, per the YC page.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic physio plus health name shared by several unrelated companies (search returned PhysioMedics and others) and no press on the brand beyond one Turkish article.

outcome_analysis: PhysioHealth was a two-founder corporate wellness app in YC Winter 2016 that appears to have raised only the YC amount reported by one aggregator. No shutdown announcement, post-mortem or acquisition was found, so the cause of inactivity is not public and failure factors stay empty.
notes: Website physioh.com returned 503 so no site content was read. The 120K round rests on a single aggregator (village.ai) which says the last round was from Y Combinator; no date given. Crunchbase snippet shows pre-seed with no amounts. Competitor entry uses a 2016 article about Virgin Pulse; ShapeUp and Global Corporate Challenge acquisitions are in a VentureBeat 2016 article. Cause of inactivity not public.
